apps.name: A small shop
apps.summary: A product page with the shop's own product card and quantity picker. One stream, drawn by each platform's own renderer, with the shop's own views for its two custom pieces.
features: A required field, checked before the button works

apps.name: A sales dashboard
apps.summary: Sales by month, today's orders and weekly visitors as charts, with a note about the month. The same lines become native charts on each platform.
features: Charts drawn natively, no chart code from the model

apps.name: The playground
apps.summary: Type or paste Omni-IR and see it drawn as you go, or copy the instructions into your own AI chat and paste its reply. Runs in the browser with a free mock model.
features: Share links that never reach a server

apps.name: A plain web page
apps.summary: The <omni-screen> element in plain HTML, with no build step. The same element works in Vue, Svelte and Angular; each has its own example.
features: The app's own component as a plain custom element

apps.name: Inside an AI chat
apps.summary: The MCP Apps view: when an assistant such as Claude calls show_screen, the screen streams into the chat and its buttons call the app's own tools.
features: Buttons call app-only tools, checked against their schemas
